author: More Perfect Union
description:
Ivanka Trump and Jared Kushner are building a 3460 acre resort on an Albanian island.

Thousands in Albania are protesting, and at the same time this isn't unique.

This is how Jared and Ivanka use their proximity to power — building developments for the rich, at our expense.
title: The Kushner Land Grab in Albania is Part of a Bigger Scheme
